statement: Every cluster-wide priority-recovery surrogate decision has one deterministic available rebalancer owner per planning generation, while each priority partition retains current-entity recovery, ownerless lost-wakeup fallback, operation safety, and the production five-node MovieLens milestone.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Do not widen the 180000ms schema budget, weaken the 60000ms stability policy, serialize scenario joins, reduce production logging, add a parallel freshness path, suppress topology or stale evidence, or rerun live without a changed deterministic owner invariant.

Preserve direct current-entity recovery for every priority partition and level-triggered recovery for an ownerless partition, but admit one cluster-wide surrogate decision through exactly one deterministic owner before move construction, capacity checks, or operation admission; bottom-level operation deduplication alone is not closure.

Express current-owner, surrogate-owner, and defer outcomes through one inspectable decision policy with explicit evidence and deterministic tie-breaking; do not add another caller-local boolean that can drift across priority rebalancers.

The terminal live proof must use the production five-node MovieLens path and complete schema admission, durable ratings creation, 100000-row preload, ratings-only split convergence, and the successful three-way affinity report.
